clue.text: Bird has a long way to go round German city

indicators.note: round says the distance phrase is wrapped around the city's name

parts.note: somewhere a long way to go is far
Ulm is a city on the Danube in Germany

explanation.surface: A bird faces a long flight around a German city.
explanation.definitionFit: The fulmar is a grey and white seabird of the petrel family, so it is an example of a bird.

clue.text: If upset, stay at home

indicators.note: upset says the two letters are knocked over and swapped

parts.note: to reside is to stay or live somewhere

explanation.surface: If you are upset, stay at home.
explanation.definitionFit: The fireside stands for home and family life, as in a cosy evening by the hearth.

clue.text: Hobble lethargically, but clearly

parts.note: to limp is to hobble
idly means lazily, without energy

explanation.surface: Someone hobbles along slowly but plainly.
explanation.definitionFit: Limpidly means in a clear, transparent way, as in limpid water or prose.

clue.text: Relatives socially acceptable to be introduced to community workers

indicators.note: to be introduced to says the acceptable letter goes inside the workers

parts.note: ants are workers in an insect colony
U means upper-class, socially acceptable in British usage

explanation.surface: Respectable relatives are introduced to community workers.
explanation.walkthrough: 'community workers' suggests social workers, but means insects in a colony. U is the old British label for upper-class, acceptable usage.
explanation.definitionFit: Aunts are relatives, the sisters of a parent.

clue.text: Obliged to pull back, when about to consider force

indicators.note: about says the reversed pulling word goes round the next pieces
back says the word for pulling is read backwards

parts.note: to lug is to pull or drag something heavy
to rate something is to consider or judge it
F is the abbreviation for force in physics

explanation.surface: Someone thankful for help pulls back and weighs up using force.
explanation.walkthrough: 'back' gives GUL, and 'about' wraps it round the rest; 'Obliged' reads as compelled, but means thankful.
explanation.definitionFit: Feeling obliged to someone means being thankful to them for a favour, a common synonym.

clue.text: Rex gets Darwinian novel

parts.note: R stands for Rex, king, as in royal signatures
Darwin's theory is the theory of evolution

explanation.surface: A man called Rex receives a novel about Darwin.
explanation.walkthrough: 'novel' reads as a book, but is the adjective meaning new.
explanation.definitionFit: Something revolutionary is radically new, which is what novel means as an adjective.

clue.text: Ring assassin, where charge is made

parts.note: to toll a bell is to ring it
John Wilkes Booth assassinated Abraham Lincoln

explanation.surface: Phone a hired killer and get charged for it.
explanation.definitionFit: A tollbooth is the kiosk on a road or bridge where drivers pay a fee.

clue.text: In favour of accepting a pound in coin

indicators.note: accepting says the word for in favour of takes the pound inside

parts.note: for means in favour of
L is the abbreviation for a pound, from Latin libra

explanation.surface: Someone happy to take a pound in coin.
explanation.definitionFit: A florin was a British two-shilling coin, used until decimalisation in 1971.

clue.text: "Make a reduction in class", we're told

indicators.note: we're told says the class word is heard rather than seen

parts.note: a lesson is a class at school

explanation.surface: A teacher's quoted order to cut back on lessons.
explanation.definitionFit: To lessen something is to reduce it or cut it down.

clue.text: Classical tale of chivalry

definitions.meaning: ... describes ancient Rome, part of the classical world
a medieval verse romance about knights

explanation.surface: A classical story of knightly deeds.
explanation.definitionFit: One sense is the ancient culture of Rome; the other is the old French word for a knightly romance.

clue.text: Father has half a dozen cats in the buildings

parts.note: Pa is an informal word for father
half a dozen is six, VI in Roman numerals
lions are big cats

explanation.surface: Dad keeps six cats in the buildings.
explanation.definitionFit: Pavilions are buildings, such as the clubhouse at a cricket ground or ornamental park structures.

clue.text: Wonky taps in reactor cause delay

indicators.note: wonky means crooked or unstable, so the letters are knocked out of order

explanation.surface: Faulty taps inside a nuclear reactor hold things up.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in' looks like a link word, but its letters are part of the fodder.
explanation.definitionFit: To procrastinate is to put off action, so to hold things up or delay.

clue.text: Will Ross's cooked a cake

indicators.note: cooked suggests the letters of the name are prepared into something new

explanation.surface: A man named Will Ross has baked a cake.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Will' looks like a verb or a first name, but it is part of the anagram fodder.
explanation.definitionFit: A Swiss roll is a sponge cake spread with jam and rolled into a spiral.

clue.text: Union member died, tucking into cheese

indicators.note: tucking into says the letter for dying goes inside the cheese

parts.note: Brie is a soft French cheese
D is the abbreviation for died in genealogies

explanation.surface: A trade unionist died while eating cheese.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Union' suggests a trade union, but here it means a marriage.
explanation.definitionFit: A marriage is a union, and the woman being married is one member of it.

clue.text: Thought of French freedom

parts.note: de is the French word for of
liberation is the act of setting free

explanation.surface: A thought about the French idea of liberty.
explanation.definitionFit: Deliberation is careful thought or consideration before a decision.

clue.text: Orchestra leader wears clean bra made in Spain

indicators.note: wears says the orchestra letter has the rearranged clothing around it
made, as in made up, signals the letters are refashioned
leader picks the first letter of the word orchestra

explanation.surface: A conductor puts on a clean bra manufactured in Spain.
explanation.definitionFit: Barcelona is the Catalan city on Spain's Mediterranean coast, so it lies in Spain.

clue.text: Relentless girl hit newsman

parts.note: Una is a girl's name
to bat is to hit
ED, editor, is a newspaper man

explanation.surface: A girl strikes a journalist without letting up.
explanation.definitionFit: Unabated means without any lessening of force, so continuing relentlessly.

clue.text: Rose, like Charlie, has finished

parts.note: as means like, in comparisons
Charlie is C in the NATO phonetic alphabet
ended means finished

explanation.surface: Rose, just like Charlie, is done.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Rose' looks like a woman named beside Charlie, but it is the past tense of rise.
explanation.definitionFit: Ascended is a past-tense synonym for rose, meaning went up.

clue.text: A senatorship arranged for Greek writer

indicators.note: arranged says the letters of the phrase are put in a new order

explanation.surface: A seat in the senate fixed up for a Greek author.
explanation.definitionFit: Aristophanes was the ancient Athenian comic playwright who wrote The Frogs and The Birds.

clue.text: Supporters of British champions

parts.note: aces are experts or champions

explanation.surface: Fans of British champions.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Supporters' reads as fans, but means straps holding up trousers, called suspenders in the US.
explanation.definitionFit: Braces are the straps over the shoulders that hold up trousers, so supporters.

clue.text: Doctor gets addict a useful cat

parts.note: MO is a medical officer, a doctor
a user is a drug addict

explanation.surface: A doctor treats an addict who turns out useful.
explanation.definitionFit: A mouser is a cat good at catching mice, valued on farms and in homes.

clue.text: Castle by edge of river

parts.note: the castle in chess is the rook, R in chess notation
to hone is to sharpen, giving an edge

explanation.surface: A castle sits near the bank of a river.
explanation.walkthrough: 'edge of river' looks like a bank, but 'edge' is the verb sharpen and 'river' alone is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: The Rhone is a major European waterway flowing from Switzerland through France to the Mediterranean.

clue.text: Cook rice with basil and make it snappy

indicators.note: to cook something can mean to alter or rework it, so the letters are mixed

explanation.surface: A recipe instruction: cook rice with basil and be quick about it.
explanation.walkthrough: 'snappy' reads as 'quick', but it means bad-tempered.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone irascible is short-tempered and quick to bite back, which is what snappy describes.

clue.text: Tory's skin problem leads to collapse

parts.note: C stands for Conservative, the Tory party
a rash is a skin complaint

explanation.surface: A Conservative politician's skin complaint causes a breakdown.
explanation.definitionFit: A crash is a sudden collapse, of a market or a person.

clue.text: Firm about nitwit's suspicious bird

indicators.note: about says the abbreviation for a firm goes round the fool

parts.note: Co is short for company, a firm
an ass is a fool
wary means cautious and suspicious

explanation.surface: A company wary of a fool comes across a strange bird.
explanation.definitionFit: The cassowary is a large flightless bird of New Guinea and northern Australia.

clue.text: Bill and Edward played

parts.note: AC, short for account, is a bill
Ted is a short form of Edward

explanation.surface: Two men named Bill and Edward performed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Bill' looks like a man's name beside 'Edward', but it is an account.
explanation.definitionFit: To have acted a part is to have played it on stage.

clue.text: Said scripture lesson is included? It's barred!

indicators.note: is included says the lesson goes inside the word for said

parts.note: stated means said or declared
RI is religious instruction, a school scripture lesson in Britain

explanation.surface: Someone claims a scripture lesson was part of it, then it is banned.
explanation.walkthrough: 'barred' looks like banned, but means marked with stripes. RI, religious instruction, is the old British school name for scripture lessons.
explanation.definitionFit: Striated means marked with parallel stripes or bands, so striped like bars.

clue.text: Bill's cast out, but protected

indicators.note: out is read as outside, so the word for cast wraps round the bill

parts.note: to shed is to cast off
an ad, short for advertisement, is a bill or poster

explanation.surface: Bill has been thrown out, but he was kept safe.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Bill's' looks like a person, but it is a poster; 'cast out' splits into cast and an outside signal.
explanation.definitionFit: Something shaded is screened from the sun, so sheltered or kept safe.
